description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to Property of Intestate in Nawaneliya, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620020
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details for multiple properties. The content falls under land registrations and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
